QuestInfo.name: [Elodin] Bird's Eye View 1
QuestInfo.0: You kicked those Dust Bundles to the curb! Talk to #b#p1501001##k again.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1501001##k asked you to go 'scold' the Howlets in #b#m101081100##k.
QuestInfo.2: You taught the Howlets a lesson just like #b#p1501001##k wanted. Go see what else she needs help with.

0.msg: All right, now I've got to handle the real headaches that pipsqueak has caused.

1.msg: I thought you liked nature... What's with all the name calling?

2.msg: Of course I love nature! But that doesn't mean I'm not upset that people are blaming #bme#k for this problem.

3.msg: That tiny howling monster is making all the noise, not me!

4.msg: I-it's not my fault they have such sensitive hearing!

6.msg: Anyway, I need your help. Go teach those #b#o3501101#s#k and #b#o3501102#s#k some perspective with a lesson about placing blame where it's due.

0.msg: There are a bunch of them in #b#m101081100##k. You'll have to teach at least #r30#k to get my point across. I'm sure of it.
Whoa! You're quicker than I thought. Maybe I should've asked you to do more.
Well, that should be good enough for now. After all, the Howlets aren't the only ones who've been a thorn in my side lately.

1.msg: Has anyone ever told you that you're pretty angry for a fairy?

0.msg: What's taking so long? They'll never learn if you don't hop to it!
